public.text: The governance section establishes governance for digital health architectures but does not explicitly address governance considerations for distributed AI operating across multiple institutions and jurisdictions.
public.suggestedRevision: As AI-enabled health systems increasingly operate across multiple organizations and jurisdictions, governance frameworks should address distributed intelligence environments in which data, models and decision-support capabilities may be developed, validated or updated collaboratively while remaining under decentralized institutional control. Governance arrangements should define accountability, oversight, transparency and lifecycle management across participating organizations.
